ann.t: Clarification of Movement in Share Price

The Exchange has sought clarification from NIS Management Ltd on November 6, 2026, with reference to Movement in Price.

The reply is awaited.

NIS Management Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 14/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve Unaudited Financial Results for the Quarter and Half Year ended 30th September 2026
